proposal.reasoning: The original purchase order 'PO-77812' for part P-4471 has a promised delivery date that was confirmed as delayed (originally promised for 2026-09-04) based on the email from the supplier on 2026-09-01 indicating a revised ship date of 2026-09-07. Since the production order 4812 needs 120 units of this part by 2026-09-07, it is necessary to reroute the order to ensure timely fulfillment.
proposal.summary_for_user: Proposing to reroute a portion of the purchase order 'PO-77812' for part 'P-4471' because the promised delivery is delayed, impacting production order '4812'.

justification: Meridian Drives has the shortest lead time of 2 days, making them the best choice for the urgent reroute.

body:
Dear Production Team,

Please be advised that we have rerouted parts for Production Order 4812. The new supplier for the part ID P-4471 is now S-Z. 

Ensure that all necessary adjustments are made in the production schedule to accommodate this change. 

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
